blocks.text: The perfect balcony by DUMSKAYA DESIGN

parts.html: When a professional designer takes on the job, even a small balcony can become a cozy, functional space for relaxing and entertaining all year round. And in our case, that means 8 square meters of pure relaxation.
Lounge area: The balcony begins with a large, comfortable corner sofa running along the walls. It is dressed with soft cushions and throws that create a cozy atmosphere.

Bar counter: An elegant bar counter with high stools runs along the balcony glazing. It is the perfect spot for morning coffee or evening cocktails with a view of the city. The counter is made of natural materials such as wood and metal, in harmony with the overall concept of the balcony.

Storage: A spacious cabinet appears to be built into one of the walls (an optical illusion), providing plenty of room for seasonal items, cushions and throws, tools, and other belongings. The cabinet has a modern, unobtrusive design that doesn’t overload the space.
Barbecue: The balcony features a compact yet functional barbecue area. The grill stands on its own base for safety and convenience.

UFO heater: A UFO heater has been installed so the balcony can be used all year round. It maintains a comfortable temperature even in the colder months, creating a cozy setting for family evenings and get-togethers with friends.

Greenery and decor: Potted plants and climbing plants trained along the beams add freshness and a natural, cozy feel. Soft lighting from floor lamps and recessed fixtures creates a romantic atmosphere in the evening.

Conclusion: A balcony like this becomes the true gem of the apartment: a functional, stylish space for relaxing and socializing that can be enjoyed all year round thanks to thoughtful design and modern solutions.
